findings.title: Plants with the same name are merged in the per-month table; harvests go to the wrong plant
findings.where: GET /api/stats/harvests (backend/routers/stats.py, GROUP BY p.name, month) and /stats table
findings.steps: Have plant 'Tomato' (Sungold, id 1). Create a second plant 'Tomato' variety 'Roma' (id 4). Log 500 g for Roma on 2026-08-12 (same month as a Sungold harvest) and 2000 g in Sep. Open /stats.
findings.expected: Sungold row: 1.05 kg (450 g Jul, 600 g Aug). Roma row: 2.5 kg (500 g Aug, 2 kg Sep). This matches the Best plants list.
findings.actual: The query groups by plant name rather than id. Roma's 500 g in August is merged into Sungold's row: Sungold shows 1.1 kg in Aug and 1.55 kg total, Roma shows 2 kg. Best plants (grouped by id) shows Roma 2.5 kg and Sungold 1.05 kg on the same page.
findings.evidence: API: plants[Tomato/Sungold].monthly_grams=[0,450,1100,0], total 1550; plants[Tomato/Roma].total_grams=2000; top_plants: Roma 2500, Sungold 1050. The page shows 'Tomato · Sungold ... 1.1 kg ... 1.55 kg' and 'Tomato · Roma ... 2 kg' while 'NO. 1 Tomato 2.5 kg · Roma'.

findings.title: Stats error state has no retry
findings.steps: On /stats, make GET /api/stats/harvests return 500 (or go offline), then change the From date. Restore the server.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that refetches without a reload.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load harvest stats.' is shown, with no retry button. The only ways to recover are editing a date or reloading.
findings.evidence: After the failure, the only buttons on the page were 'Sign out' and 'This year'.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout; a hung API leaves 'Loading stats…' forever
findings.steps: Route /api/stats/harvests to never respond, then change the From date. Wait more than 10 s.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s and shows an error with a retry.
findings.actual: The page still showed 'Loading stats…' after 13 s, with no error and no way out.
findings.evidence: main text after 13 s: 'From To This year Loading stats…'

findings.title: A null month in the response crashes rendering (formatMonth calls .slice on null); the page gets stuck on old data plus 'Loading stats…'
findings.steps: Mock /api/stats/harvests to return 200 with months:[{month:null,total_grams:null}], plants with null name/fields, top_plants:null. Change the date.
findings.expected: The untrusted response is handled. The page shows an error or placeholders, never a crash.
findings.actual: TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading 'slice')' opens the Nuxt error overlay. The page still shows the previous range's data under a stuck 'Loading stats…'. top_plants:null would also throw in v-for/length checks.
findings.evidence: Error dialog text 'TypeError ... Cannot read properties of null (reading 'slice')'; main shows 'Loading stats…' followed by the old table.

findings.title: Long plant names make the table's first column huge at 375 px, so all numbers are off-screen
findings.steps: Create a plant with an 80-character name with no spaces and harvest it. View /stats at 375 px wide.
findings.expected: The name wraps or truncates, so weights stay visible at phone width.
findings.actual: The row header is nowrap, so the first column is 833 px wide inside a 309 px scroll box. On load, no month or total column is visible, only plant names.
findings.evidence: The .table-scroll is 309 px wide with scrollWidth 1345 and a first column 833 px wide. A screenshot shows only the PLANT column. The page itself does not scroll sideways.

findings.title: A blank From/To field silently uses the default year bound, so the input and results disagree, and can give a confusing error
findings.steps: Clear the From field. Separately, set To to 2025-06-01 and clear From.
findings.expected: A blank field is refused with a visible reason, or the input shows the date being used.
findings.actual: With From blank, the field shows nothing but results say '1 Jan 2026 to ...'. With From blank and To in a past year, the server fills in this year's start and answers 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' even though From is empty.
findings.evidence: Blank From: input value '' and text '7 harvests from 1 Jan 2026 to 31 Dec 2026'.
